# Where to look in the RO-Crate 1.3 specification

Base: https://www.researchobject.org/ro-crate/specification/1.3/ (single-page: https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.3 ; Markdown: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20720080). Swap `1.3` for `1.2`, `1.1`, `1.0` for older versions (1.0/1.1 are single pages).

| Topic | Page (anchor) |
|---|---|
| Overview, walkthrough, terminology | `index` / `introduction`, `terminology` |
| Attached/detached crates, metadata document, preview | `structure` |
| Metadata principles, schema.org, other vocabularies, recommended identifiers | `metadata` |
| Metadata descriptor, finding the root, root properties, root identifier | `root-data-entity` |
| Files, directories, web-based entities, distributions, encodings, referencing other crates, retrieving a crate | `data-entities` (`#web-based-data-entities`, `#referencing-other-ro-crates`, `#retrieving-an-ro-crate`) |
| People, organisations, citation, funding, licences, places, keywords, time, thumbnails | `contextual-entities` |
| `mainEntity`, `mentions` | `crate-focus` |
| Software, equipment, change history, repository (PCDM) objects | `provenance` |
| Profiles, Profile Crates | `profiles` |
| Workflows, scripts, Bioschemas | `workflows` |
| BagIt, ELN, repository identifiers | `appendix/implementation-notes` |
| JSON-LD, context, media type, extending, ad hoc terms | `appendix/jsonld` |
| Relative URIs, base URIs, attached/detached conversion | `appendix/relative-uris` |
| Changelog | `appendix/changelog` |

Other project pages: quick reference of all requirements https://www.researchobject.org/ro-crate/quick-reference ; what changed in 1.2 `/whats-changed-in-1-2` and 1.3 `/whats-changed-in-1-3` ; profiles `/profiles` (registry https://profiles.ro-crate.org/) ; tools `/tools` ; examples `/examples`. Verify page and anchor names if a link 404s: the site layout changed between releases.
